summary: This is a DSH plugin that connects an AI agent to a local MATLAB instance via file-based IPC, exposing `matlab_*` tools for reading/editing editor content and interacting with Simulink models.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This repository is primarily an automation plugin for connecting an AI agent with a local MATLAB/Simulink environment: the DSH Node host plugin and MATLAB daemon exchange task and response JSON files to expose 20 `matlab_*` tools for editor/code inspection and Simulink model operations. The core capability set includes command execution and model mutation actions, so it is useful for agent-driven MATLAB workflows but carries elevated local risk from direct code and model modification.
